_how: Run Good Life posts one video per break on its second YouTube channel, youtube.com/@rungoodbreaks (Daniel, Nov 26, 2026). Add a page id with its video id and the video's title. A page listed here shows its own break video in place of the night's marathon stream. Pages not listed keep the stream. Then run python3 build/breaks/build.py.
